relationship_to_durable_task_continuatio: separate versioned object, referenced by authority_id; not merged into contract.v0.json's durable_task_continuation block
core_invariant: absence of original Human authorization text in a fresh session must not by itself invalidate a still-valid AuthorityRecord

future_host_boundary.host_responsibilities: persist AuthorityRecord objects, structurally validate against this schema, fence authority_epoch writes, project records to workers
future_host_boundary.host_does_not: derive/compute authorized vs human_required itself, require or store original chat transcript text
future_host_boundary.host_may: mechanically dispatch on the exact WNS-produced evaluation.decision (authorized -> attach projection and continue; human_required -> stop and escalate using evaluation.reason_code)
